clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/users/create with various password lengths to test boundaries
clean_repro.observed: Password length 7 chars: HTTP 200 success (code=0). Password length 6 chars: HTTP 200 success (code=0). Password length 73 chars: HTTP 200 error (code=1100, 'out of range 6 <= value <= 72'). Source code validates range [6, 72], not [8, 64] as contract states.
clean_repro.evidence_cmd: python -c "import requests; r = requests.post('http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/users/create', json={'userName': 'testuser7', 'password': 'abcdefg'}); print(r.status_code, r.json())"

source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现:合同断言'8 <= len(password) <= 64'与源码实现'MinPasswordLength=6, MaxPasswordLength=72'不一致。源码接受6-7字符密码(合同应拒)和65-72字符密码(合同应拒)。

falsification.probe: Tested multiple password lengths against actual API behavior
falsification.observed: Password=7 chars succeeds (HTTP 200, code=0) despite contract requiring >=8. Password=65 chars succeeds despite contract requiring <=64. API only rejects <6 or >72 per source code.

cognition_match.note: 未命中特定的by_design_pattern。此为文档与实现不一致的纯技术问题。

verdicts.rationale: 合同明确规定password长度必须在[8,64]范围内，但源码实现实际验证范围为[6,72]。实测证明API接受7字符密码(违反合同下限)和65-72字符密码(违反合同上限)。这是真正的文档-实现不匹配缺陷，源码接地明确证实了这一点。
